text: I am writing this email in order to let you know that at this point in time the report will not be ready until Friday.
It was decided by the team that the budget would be reviewed by us again next week.
Maria, I just wanted to reach out and touch base with you regarding the contract, because I was wondering if you had maybe had a chance to look at it yet.
The meeting that we had planned to have on Thursday at 3 pm is something that we are going to need to move to a different time.
Please be advised that the invoice for $4,200 has not been paid yet, and we would appreciate it if you could make sure it gets paid.
Due to the fact that the deadline is very close, we need to make a decision about what we are going to do very soon.
In my opinion I think that the Q3 numbers are basically quite good overall.
The onboarding process is a process that takes a long time and it is confusing and new hires often get lost in it.
I wanted to ask if it would be possible for you to possibly send me the slides, John, if that is okay with you.
The server went down on Monday and it went down because the disk was full and nobody noticed that the disk was full.
I would like to inform everyone that I will unfortunately be unable to attend the standup today.
@sam I have completed my review of the PR and I have left a number of comments for your consideration.
Would you perhaps be interested in joining us for lunch at 12:30 today, if your schedule permits?
It has come to my attention that the build is currently failing again at the present time.
The mockups have been uploaded to #design by me so that everyone is able to take a look at them.
Thank you very much for all of your assistance with the docs, it is greatly appreciated by me.
Hey, just checking in on the proposal, any chance we get it by Friday?
Thanks a ton for the heads up, we'll get the stuff ready for the board on June 12.
Dr. Patel, sorry but I can't make the call, can we do it some other time?
So basically the audit went fine, there were a couple of small things but nothing huge.
The report will be ready on Friday.
Hi Maria, have you had a chance to review the contract?
Please pay the outstanding invoice of $4,200 by the end of the month.
Thank you for your help. I will send the updated draft on Thursday.

sounds good 👍 see you at 3

build is green again, thanks for the quick fix!
